name: healthy-pots-platform
description: Healthy Pots: prepaid meal-subscription platform (NestJS API + Next.js web + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run start:dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
